content: In Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka argues that Zamakhsharī's Kashshāf, which every teacher promotes and takes pride in mastering, pushes blatant Muʿtazili doctrine in defending the createdness of the Quran, a position deemed kufr by all leading Hanafis and Shafiʿis, and is in fact explicitly anti-Sunna.
